create_bar_plot: create an interactive Bokeh bar plot from a ColumnDataSource with vertical or horizontal orientation
create_histogram_plot: create an interactive Bokeh histogram plot with configurable bins and hover tooltips for data visualization
create_scatter_plot: create an interactive Bokeh scatter plot with multiple data sources, color palettes, and hover tooltips
create_line_plot: create an interactive Bokeh line plot with multiple data sources, legend labels, and hover tooltips
plot_marginal: plot marginal or joint density distributions for one or two random variables with KDE and histogram overlays
